description: In a well-order with no maximum, the club predicate is equivalent to ordinal closedness and strict unboundedness.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Clubs.club_iff.{u} {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] [WellFoundedLT α] [NoMaxOrder α] (C : Set α) :
  IsClub C ↔ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Clubs.IsOrdinalClosed C ∧ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Clubs.IsUnbounded C
